tagline: Pilates and Barre teacher training in Altrincham, Greater Manchester. Small cohorts, in-person coaching, Contrology to Contemporary.
accreditationStatements: Our courses are internationally accredited by ITTAP through the Pilates Method Alliance (PMA).
The Pilates Programme is a CIMSPA Training Partner.
insuranceNote: You will need teacher insurance before you teach paid classes. Budget for an annual policy from a specialist fitness insurer.
parkingNote: Parking is available nearby. The centre is a short walk from Altrincham train and tram interchange.
